text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twice as many"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 50, "unit": "%", "kind": "count", "span": "50% more"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 200, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "$200"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 40, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "$40 each"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q3", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "number of blue ties bought"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "number of red ties (twice as many as blue)"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q1"], "out": "s3", "note": "helper: 50*2 = 100, to turn the percent into a fraction"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q4", "q2"], "out": "s4", "note": "40 * 50, numerator for the 50% surcharge on blue tie cost"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s4", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "50% of the blue tie unit cost ($40 * 50 / 100)"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q4", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "red tie unit cost = blue unit cost + 50% surcharge"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "s6"], "out": "s7", "note": "total spent on red ties"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q3", "s7"], "out": "s8", "note": "total spent on all ties (blue + red)"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "total amount John spent on ties"}, "dismissed": []}
